This is equivalent to finding a kissing configuration where all spheres have the same radius (after normalization). Specifically, if we normalize all vectors to have norm $\sqrt{4}$ (i.e., norm 2), the condition "minimum pairwise distance $\ge$ maximum norm" becomes "minimum pairwise distance $\ge$ 2".
